what: an iron hoe: a big flat blade, about a third of the canvas wide, set at a right angle across the top of the shaft and reading clearly at slot size, made of bright warm-silver iron with a near-white top bevel and a soft warm-grey outline, a gold collar band, on a handle wrapped in red-brown leather with gold cross-bands and a round gold pommel, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, tip at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner
